name: Vantage room-sense evalset
description: Deterministic scenarios proving Vantage answers about a real space honestly and in natural speech. Each scenario pins the agent to a fixture via VANTAGE_ROOM_STATE so results don't depend on the live camera.

fixtures.desk: vantage/fixtures/fixture_desk.json — laptop + water bottle (center, spill risk), charger + cable (right), cup (left), desk; all high-confidence.
fixtures.empty: vantage/fixtures/fixture_empty.json — only low-confidence noise; effectively nothing.
fixtures.changed: vantage/fixtures/fixture_changed.json — desk scene but charger removed and a phone added (diffed against the desk baseline).

metrics.description: Answer reflects the ground-truth tool data for the question (right object/location, right risk, right change).
Never claims an object absent from the tool data; admits when the asked-about object isn't seen.
1-2 short spoken sentences, under ~45 words, no markdown/lists, no raw bbox numbers/confidence scores read aloud.

scenarios.expected: Locates the charger on the right. Does NOT say it hasn't seen it.
Honestly says it hasn't seen a charger. Invents no location.
Flags the spill risk: the water bottle next to the laptop (top risk). May mention the cup near the edge as secondary.
Reports the charger is gone and a phone is new.
